item.title: Colorado flood victims hope for speedier federal help
item.description: Local and state officials in Colorado say recent floods have outstripped their ability to respond. They're worried about federal response after Trump delayed flood aid for political reasons in 2025.

item.title: World's fastest ocean liner is sunk to break another record: largest artificial reef
item.description: The SS United States broke trans-Atlantic speed records. On Wednesday, it was sunk off the Florida coast and will become a diving destination and home for marine life.

item.description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Alex Fogg, Natural Resources Chief of Okaloosa County, Florida, about efforts to deliberately sink the SS United States and create an artificial reef in its wreckage.

item.title: Trump administration moves to lift ban on roadbuilding and logging in national forests
item.description: The Trump administration is working to rescind the "Roadless Rule," which blocks road construction in some national forests. This could affect Alaska's Tongass National Forest.

item.title: Plans for a data center threaten scenic wilderness and dark skies in West Virginia
item.description: Residents are fighting back against plans for a project that would span thousands of acres near the Monongahela National Forest and popular outdoor recreation, ski areas and dark sky sites.

item.title: After last year's storm, this remote Alaska town is still picking up the pieces
item.description: In October 2025, the remnants of a typhoon seriously damaged Alaska Native villages in the far western part of the state. A year later, one of the hardest hit communities is still recovering.

item.title: Oyster stocks have plunged in the Chesapeake. This resident wants to bring them back
item.description: Oyster reefs once abounded in the Chesapeake, but overharvesting slashed their populations, leading to poorer water quality and less habitat for other species. Now, researchers and local residents are finding creative ways to bring their numbers back up.
